remarks: Tow bedroom deluxe Type G layout located on the valley side of the premier Tamarack Club. Ownership gives you 10-11 pre-determined weeks per year, on a rotating basis so you don't have the same weeks each year. This type of unit gives you the chance to use half of the unit and rent the other half, or rent the entire unit. Ownership amenities include year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, private owner locker room, owner's lounge fitness center, sauna, valet parking, underground parking while lodging overnight, and discounts on skiing, golf, and at the restaurant on site.
